cand.title: 2027 Retailers Insurance Company Incentive Trip
cand.excerpt: Ranked on evidence strength, hospitality mechanism, Punta Cana fit and accessibility; no unsupported attendance or room-night assumptions.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Three verified program-facing contacts appear on the 2027 announcement: Kurt Dettmer, Senior Vice President, Insurance Sales and Business Development; Tom Tuggle, Senior Vice President, Insurance Sales and Partner Relations; and Nick Barnes, Director, Insurance Sales. All three are also assistance contacts on the historical 2026 registration page. They are credible organizer-side relationship entry points, not proven hotel contract signatories. The general management page describes Tuggle instead as Senior Vice President, Insurance Sales & Membership, MRA; use the event-page title for program outreach and confirm his current remit.
findings.futureEdition: The organizer explicitly announces a 2027 incentive trip to Royal Beach, Punta Cana. Actual arrival/departure dates are not published in the reviewed announcement or located elsewhere in the researched official material. December 1, 2025–December 1, 2026 is the qualification window, NOT the trip. The 2027 edition year falls within the requested horizon, but exact activity dates remain unverified. No 2028 edition was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: a beach-resort, guestroom-led couples incentive is directionally suitable for Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana, unlike a large city-hotel congress. Wyndham publishes 620 rooms, all-inclusive amenities, outdoor event settings and 380 m² across three meeting facilities, with capacity for 300 conference or 200 banquet guests. No RIC attendance, peak rooms or meeting agenda is published, so capacity fit cannot be qualified. The incumbent offer includes Preferred Club swim-out/private-pool suites, butler service and luxury amenities at an adults-only resort; equivalent accommodation and experience at Alltra must be demonstrated rather than assumed.
findings.venueCommitments: Secrets Royal Beach Punta Cana is the announced host hotel, supported by the dedicated organizer trip page, its property-specific URL and advertised Preferred Club benefits. The organizer promises qualifiers a Preferred Club Swim-Out or Private Pool Suite and round-trip air for two. This is an event-specific venue announcement, not generic resort promotion. No signed contract, room-block quantity, release date or exclusivity terms were published.
findings.historicalRotation: One earlier edition is verified: March 1–5, 2026, Secrets St. Lucia. The next announced edition is 2027 at Secrets Royal Beach Punta Cana. These establish destination/property change between two editions, not a documented annual rotation policy or future return to Punta Cana. No verified 2023–2025 host timeline or announced 2028 destination was located.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 lodging is already packaged around the announced Secrets host. Sixteen points qualify a couple; agencies may qualify multiple couples. Four additional points earn one room-extension night, up to three nights; purchased extensions are offered up to three days before/after at the published $1,020 nightly charge plus additional flight expenses. This is extension demand at the incumbent, not an open accommodation RFP. Historical 2026 registration routed room/accessibility requests through RIC, referenced an unnamed travel agent for flight upgrades and resort-issued payment links for extra nights. The same supplier arrangement for 2027 is not verified. No named DMC/PCO or open sourcing process was found.
findings.organizationStructure: RIC is an insurance company originating in a Michigan Retailers Association group self-insured fund established in 1981 and converted to an insurance company in 2006. This is an insurer-led agency sales incentive, not an association convention or PCO-owned event. Qualification rewards bound insurance policies and sold merchant-processing referrals. RIC is the program organizer; Secrets is the announced host. The hotel buyer, contracting legal entity and any external planning intermediary remain unverified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The announced 2027 business belongs to Secrets Royal Beach Punta Cana, not Wyndham Alltra. Premium suite categories, Preferred Club privileges, butler service and included extensions create a specific competitive benchmark. No evidence of incumbent sell-out, overflow, displaced rooms, split housing, dissatisfaction or an invitation to substitute hotels was found. Do not classify extension offers as overflow or calculate room demand from unlimited agency qualification.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Kurt Dettmer and Tom Tuggle with Nick Barnes as an additional program contact. Acknowledge the announced Secrets Royal Beach placement; request the actual 2027 travel dates, identity of the hotel-sourcing/contracting lead and any appointed travel agency. Ask when a later incentive cycle will be sourced and whether Uvero Alto and Alltra’s product would be considered. Only if invited, prepare a guestroom-led all-inclusive incentive proposal with a documented suite/VIP-benefit comparison and a right-sized awards function; do not issue a speculative overflow or 2027 room-block proposal.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: No evidenced open hotel-sourcing path for the announced 2027 edition. Treat it as venue-confirmed at a competitor and not currently accessible for a primary room block without organizer-confirmed changes. Legal contract closure/exclusivity is unknown. The separate March 2026 St. Lucia trip is expired and is retained only as history.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: two successive announced resort incentives and ongoing agent incentive communications support a relationship-development hypothesis for a later competitive cycle. They do not establish a 2028 event, open bid, annual procurement timetable, brand exclusivity or future Punta Cana selection. Seek an invitation to a genuinely uncommitted later edition rather than pursuing unsupported 2027 displacement.
